route_why: proof purana ho raha hai — jo June mein seekha uska aakhri saboot lock-day ka hai

plan.text: Aaj Re-Jirah hai — tokenization, jo June mein lock hua tha. Main sirf poochhunga, batauunga kuch nahi. Nau strike, ek-ek axis. Har jawab se pehle ek gut-word bolo, phir poora jawab. Notes band, capsule band. Shuru karo?
Pehla strike, thanda. Token kya hai exactly — aur tokenization ka kaam KAHAN khatam hota hai? Jawab se pehle ek gut-word: pakka, halka, ya andaaza?
Word-level toh seedha hai — har word ka ek number, khatam. Toh subword-BPE ki poori jhanjhat kyun paali? Aur tokenization ko poora skip karke seedha text kyun nahi de sakte? Pehle gut-word bolo?

Factory pehle vocab banati hai, freeze kar deti hai, phir tu sirf lookup karta hai. Ab maan le 'COVID' jaisa naya word aaya — jo training ke baad bana, vocab mein tha hi nahi. Model crash karega? Gut-word pehle?
Teri apni hero line: 'Aristo Eco - Rs81,500'. Yeh kitne token banegi? Vocab ka size kitna hota hai? Aur bina tool ke token count ka andaaza kaise lagayega? Gut-word pehle bolo?
Rs81,500 aur Rs81,400 — model ke andar yeh do paas-paas baithenge, ya bilkul ajnabi? Aur isse teri TDS wali decision pe kya farak padta hai? Gut-word pehle?
Badi vocab matlab kam token — sasta bhi, context bhi bachta. Toh sab log seedha bahut badi vocab kyun nahi rakh lete? Kaunsi cheez tootne lagti hai jab dial badhaate ho? Gut-word pehle?

Manager saamne baitha hai: 'Claude itna powerful hai, do percent khud nikaal lega — code mein math likhna over-engineering hai. Convince me.' Bolo. Aur agar wo phir bhi na maane, tu kya karega? Gut-word pehle?
Ek invoice tokenize karna chillar hai. Ab production — ek lakh invoice mahine mein. Kya-kya tootta hai wahan, aur sabse pehle kya tootega? Gut-word pehle bolo?

Hiring manager non-technical hai: 'main technical nahi hoon — tokenization se mujhe, ek business wale ko, kya farak padta hai? Tees second, koi jargon nahi.' Phir uska agla sawaal: 'agar yeh itna basic step hai toh skip kyun nahi kar sakte?' Gut-word pehle?
